name: LUSTER
recent: Luster Industries 在2026年11月25日公布截至9月30日的季度业绩，净利为974万令吉。此前于8月底公布截至6月底季度业绩，营收6,371万令吉、净利271万令吉。董事经理Chuah Chong Ewe等高管在10月表明可能在闭市期交易公司股票。
notable: 截至2026年9月30日季度净利974万令吉。
截至2026年6月30日季度营收6,371万令吉，净利271万令吉。
董事经理及执行董事在闭市期表明可能交易公司股票。
risks: 董事在闭市期表明可能交易公司股票。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日季度，营收6,371万令吉，环比增2.4%，同比增4.4%；净利271万令吉，环比增6,859%，净利率4.3%，高于上季的0.1%。

recent_en: Luster Industries reported a net profit of RM9.74 million for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 on 25 November 2026. It earlier announced results for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 with revenue of RM63.71 million and net profit of RM2.71 million. In October, Managing Director Chuah Chong Ewe and other executives indicated intention to trade the company's shares during the closed period.
notable_en: Net profit of RM9.74 million for the quarter ended 30 September 2026.
Revenue of RM63.71 million and net profit of RM2.71 million for the quarter ended 30 June 2026.
Managing Director and Executive Directors indicated possible trading of company shares during closed period.
risks_en: Directors indicated possible trading of company shares during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM63.71 million, up 2.4% QoQ and 4.4% YoY; net profit was RM2.71 million, up 6,859% QoQ, with net margin at 4.3% versus 0.1% in the prior quarter.
